headline: Why Dior’s Jonathan Anderson Is Inspired by Lynda Benglis
context: Lynda Benglis redefined sculpture in the 1960s. No longer overlooked, her audacious talent moves from museums to runways, transformed by Dior’s Jonathan Anderson.
